answer: Under the delta, identity is earned rather than claimed — no proof, no seat at the table. A newcomer enters only when an established sponsor locks a bond behind it, and the bond is slashed if the newcomer is later proven fake. The cedar check ties the sponsor's own standing to every vouch, so backing a thousand clones needs a thousand sponsors willing to lose money and reputation. Through the lagoon, one real agent costs once and a thousand pretenders cost a thousand times — no shortcut survives that math.
